name: ezpowers
description: Personal Codex workflow plugin for spec-driven planning, command-document guidance, and explicit EZPowers skills.

interface.shortDescription: Spec-driven planning, reviews, and workflow skills for Codex.
interface.longDescription: EZPowers exposes Codex skills such as ezpowers:diagnose, ezpowers:frontend-design, and ezpowers:verifyself. The setup, design_architecture, spec, prepare_execute, choice_execute, review, sync, eval, and feedback procedures remain command documents under commands/ for agents to read and execute when requested.
